news.title: New York Democrats advance redistricting ballot measure, tee up second vote
news.summary: New York Democrats advanced a redistricting ballot measure on Wednesday making it easier for Democrats to redraw the state’s congressional lines — putting the state a step closer toward creating a more favorable House map ahead of 2028.
